entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor's-level degree in engineering or in basic, applied or health sciences.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor’s-level degree in engineering or in basic, applied, or health sciences.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 1, 2026 for the Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry and Physics tracks, and December 15, 2026 for the other tracks; the table prints no year.
deadline.quote: Materials Science and Engineering (Joint PhD) December 1 (Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics)

also.quote: December 15 (Chemical and Biological Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The School of Engineering says full-time PhD students often receive a tuition scholarship; the page does not say that most are funded.

also.quote: Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required except on the Computer Science track, which requires it for applicants without a US or Canadian degree.
gre_general.quote: For applicants to all other tracks, GRE General Test scores are not required.

also.quote: For applicants to the Computer Science track, GRE scores are required, unless the applicant will have received a degree from an institution located in the U.S. or Canada by time of enrollment.

notes: This is a joint PhD run through the Chemistry, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Civil, ECE, Mechanical and Computer Science departments, each with its own track. GRE rules differ by track (see gre_general). TOEFL 'recommend at least' and 'competitive' wording is not a minimum, so no toefl_min is saved.
